details.description: ft:gpt-3.5-turbo is the identifier prefix OpenAI uses for chat models fine-tuned from its GPT-3.5 Turbo base model, producing ids of the form ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0125:{org}:{suffix}:{id}. GPT-3.5 Turbo itself is a legacy model with a 16,385-token context window, a 4,096-token max output, and a September 1, 2021 knowledge cutoff; OpenAI's own model page places it in its lowest 'Intelligence' tier and recommends GPT-4o Mini in its place as of July 2024. OpenAI is winding down its fine-tuning platform: it is closed to new users, and this base model, along with fine-tuned models built on it, is scheduled to lose API access on October 23, 2026.
advantages: OpenAI's model page lists fine-tuning as a supported feature of GPT-3.5 Turbo, letting customers train the underlying model on their own example prompts and responses.

OpenAI describes supervised fine-tuning, the technique this model supports, as well suited to classification, nuanced translation, generating content in a specific format, and correcting instruction-following failures (OpenAI's supervised fine-tuning guide).
disadvantages: OpenAI is winding down its fine-tuning platform: it is closed to new users, though existing users can still create jobs for a limited time, and inference on already fine-tuned models continues only until the base model is deprecated (OpenAI's supervised fine-tuning guide).
OpenAI's deprecations page schedules ft-gpt-3.5-turbo for shutdown on October 23, 2026, with gpt-5.6-terra listed as the recommended replacement base model.
OpenAI's current model page places GPT-3.5 Turbo in its lowest 'Intelligence' and 'Speed' tiers among listed models, and recommends GPT-4o Mini in its place as of July 2024.
Text-only input and output with no image, audio, or video support, and a September 1, 2021 knowledge cutoff (OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page).
use_cases: Continued inference on chat models already fine-tuned from GPT-3.5 Turbo before OpenAI closed the fine-tuning platform to new users.
Supervised fine-tuning to generate content in a specific format.
Supervised fine-tuning to correct instruction-following failures.

notes: 'ft:gpt-3.5-turbo' without an org/suffix/id is an id-scheme prefix rather than a single callable model; OpenAI's own example fine-tuned checkpoint id is 'ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0125:my-org:custom-suffix:96olL566:ckpt-step-2000'. OpenAI's deprecations page groups the row as 'gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 | gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo-completions', i.e. gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 is the snapshot the bare 'gpt-3.5-turbo' alias currently points to, and lists 'ft-gpt-3.5-turbo' fine-tuned models for the same October 23, 2026 shutdown. Catalog facts (16,385 max input, 4,096 max output, text-only modality, 2026-10-23 deprecation, /v1/chat/completions endpoint) match OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page and deprecations page. Web search was unavailable for this session (budget exhausted), so research relied on directly fetching OpenAI's own docs pages.
